## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.7
**New** - **Blackout built-in display** — the Displays menu now has a single **Blackout Built-in Display** switch: it mirrors your built-in screen to an external display and blacks the built-in out in one click, with a **Displays…** button to open macOS display settings. Hover it for a quick explanation of what it does.
**Improvements** - **Window focus** — focusing quadrants or the center now skips windows you've since moved out of place or minimized, and **Focus Center** only targets a centered, quarter-size window. - **Snappier tooltips** — menu tooltips now appear promptly instead of after a long pause.
